title: Every stationary Wick-dominant finite-Fisher state is bounded below by its moment-matched Gaussian

stationary_reduction.admitted_class: At cutoff N, let T_N^+ contain translation-invariant finite-Fisher wavefunctions whose spatial mean h is constant, whose covariance S commutes with torus translations, and whose integrated non-Gaussian Wick defect int[4h mu3(x)+mu4(x)-3v(x)^2]dx is nonnegative.
stationary_reduction.material_nongaussian_members: The class contains non-Gaussian stationary laws with symmetric centered fluctuations and nonnegative fourth cumulant, including translation-invariant linear images of independent symmetric positive-kurtosis coordinates and stationary Gaussian scale mixtures with finite Fisher information.
stationary_reduction.free_reduction: K1533 gives q0[psi]>=(1/4){h^T Omega h+Tr[Omega(S+S^(-1)-2I)]}; equality requires the moment-matched Gaussian amplitude and a constant phase.
stationary_reduction.interaction_reduction: K1534 gives E W_N=E_Gauss W_N+int[4h mu3+mu4-3v^2], so the admitted defect sign makes the interaction no smaller than that of the same-mean, same-covariance Gaussian.
stationary_reduction.stationary_diagonalization: Translation invariance makes the covariance Fourier diagonal (with the real-mode conjugacy convention) and the mean a zero-mode constant, so the moment-matched Gaussian lies exactly in K1572's stationary diagonal class.
stationary_reduction.finite_cutoff_consequence: For every psi in T_N^+, its Rayleigh quotient is at least the quotient of its moment-matched stationary diagonal Gaussian. Since every stationary diagonal Gaussian has zero defect and belongs to T_N^+, the two finite-cutoff variational infima are equal.
stationary_reduction.scope_guard: The theorem does not cover nonstationary laws, negative integrated defect, thin bimodal likelihoods, arbitrary negative fourth cumulant, or an unrestricted non-Gaussian ground state.
